definition: Old-fashioned and no longer suitable for modern life.
author: Washington Irving
quote: Buxom lasses, almost as antiquated as their mothers, excepting where a straw hat, a fine ribbon, or perhaps a white frock, gave symptoms of city innovation.
example_sentence: The office still uses an antiquated fax machine.
